generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e 2021-2022 to 2025-2026 Achieved in at least two financial years an average financial turnover of Rs23,00,000 lakhs Certified turnover certificate issued by the Chartered accountant with UDIN number attach certified balance sheet and profit loss statement

The bidder shall have satisfactorily completed, as a Prime Contractor at least one work of a similar nature having a value of not less than 50Percent of the estimated cost of the work, not less than 11,50,000 during the last five financial years. The bidder shall submit a Work Done Certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer
Contract Registration Certificate Registration Certificate issued by PWD officer not below the ranking of Chief engineer

The bidder shall have liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than 690000 in the form of credit lines letters of credit or certificates issued by a Scheduled/Nationalized Bank for meeting the fund requirements of the work. The certificate shall be issued on the bank official letterhead and shall be valid as on the last date fixed for submission of the tender
